label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.4… supports Whatever is its own subsistent being is no…
note: Q.4 a.1 ad 3 says esse 'non comparatur ad alia sicut recipiens ad receptum: sed magis sicut receptum ad recipiens'. The claim formalizes only that nothing has actuality except insofar as it is. The step from esse as such to a being that is its own esse, and from 'not related as recipient' to 'no act is received in it', is not stated.
